title: Dissociated permission decision record
description: Records a single permission decision independently of any findings. References findings by SHA-256 ID only — never embeds finding content, severity, or evidence. Designed to enforce the invariant from MATURE_AGENT_DESIGN_DECOMPOSITION_v0.2 §4.3: heuristic findings must not masquerade as security proofs, and permissions must not erase findings.

referenced_finding_ids.description: SHA-256 finding_ids of findings considered for this decision. References findings by identity only — finding content, severity, and evidence live independently in the finding registry.
